mentions.name: Cellar contents tracker (web & mobile app)
mentions.description: A web and mobile app for tracking cellar contents, designed to feel modern rather than dated or clunky, with the ability to create assorted dynamically-updating menus for different use cases. Still in development, with a Show HN planned once it is live.
mentions.problem: Existing cellar tracking options feel dated and clunky.
mentions.audience: Cellar owners who want to track and browse their cellar contents
mentions.source_excerpt: A web and mobile app for tracking cellar contents that doesn't feel dated or clunky, and with which I can make assorted dynamically-updating menus for different use cases. I'll probably do a Show HN once it's live.

evidence.value: A web and mobile app for tracking cellar contents that doesn't feel dated or clunky, and with which I can make assorted dynamically-updating menus for different use cases. I'll probably do a Show HN once it's live.
